fato_historico: 1957: Sputnik 1 becomes the first artificial satellite to orbit the Earth.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to launch your own bold ambitions into the atmosphere, much like a pioneering vessel finding its path among the distant stars. You may find that your natural drive is exceptionally high today, making it a perfect time to consider starting a new personal project or setting your sights on a lofty, shimmering horizon.
frase_do_dia: Even the smallest spark can orbit the world if given enough courage.
significado_numero: A stable foundation for your most ambitious dreams to take root.
conselho: Trust your inner compass and take that first leap toward your dreams.
